empty: No literature digests yet. The AI agent can read a folder's papers and compare or summarize them.
note: A literature digest is material prepared from several papers in advance. When a Workflow starts, the AI agent reads it first and checks citations against the original papers' pages.

status.pendingTip: The researcher has not checked the content yet

origin.gaidTip: A literature digest the AI agent made from library papers with a general Workflow
origin.externalTip: A summary imported from a file exported from Gemini Notebook. Never used as a citation source

detail.missing: The digest file was not found in its project. Showing the copy kept in the library.
detail.question: Research question
detail.externalLimit: An external summary is read for reference only and never used as a citation source.
detail.useTitle: Project to attach the covered papers to
detail.usedIn: The Workflow start window in {name} can now read it first
detail.useFailed: Could not attach the covered papers to the project. Try again.
detail.statusFailed: Could not change the status. Try again.
detail.removeConfirm: Removes the external summary and the imported file record from the library.
detail.removeConfirmMade: Removes it from the library. The digest file stays in the project.
detail.removeFailed: Could not remove it from the library. Try again.
detail.stale: {count} papers were added to the folder {folder} after the digest was made.
detail.coversNone: None of its papers are still in the library.
detail.unmatched: {count} sources not in the library were not linked.
detail.truncated: Only the beginning is kept in the library. The full text is in the original file.

make.title: Make a literature digest
make.context: The AI agent reads the chosen papers, writes a comparison or summary with a citation list, and adds it to the library.
make.papersHint: Choose a library folder. Papers in its subfolders are read too.
make.noPdf: For {count} papers without a PDF only the record and abstract are read.
make.kindHint: Made with one of the general Workflows in GAID.

kinds.compare-papersHint: Compares claims, methods, data and limits in one table with page citations.
kinds.summarize-paperHint: Summarizes each paper's objective, methods, findings and significance separately. No comparison table.
kinds.methods-comparisonHint: Compares methods for the research question by strengths, weaknesses and the data they need.

why.compare-papers: Recommended because two or more papers are chosen.
why.summarize-paper: Recommended because one paper is chosen.

make.question: Research question
make.questionHint: The digest is organised around it. Write one or two sentences.
make.questionPlaceholder: For example: what does a petrophysically constrained inversion add to the orebody boundary
make.whereHint: The AI agent reads in a chat of this project and the output file stays in its 문헌정리 folder. The chosen papers join the project's citation scope.
make.noProjects: No projects. Create a project, then open this again.

reason.question: Write the research question.
reason.project: Choose the project to work in.

make.footer: Puts the request into a new chat of the project. When you send it, the AI agent starts, and the result enters the library as not reviewed.

error.failed: Could not create the request. Try again.
error.gone: The project or folder was not found. Reopen the list and choose again.
error.tooMany: A digest holds up to 60 papers. Choose a subfolder instead.

picker.empty: No literature digests in the library. You can make one from a folder's papers in the library.
picker.withPapers: Also add the {count} papers it covers as sources
picker.withPapersHint: The evidence view beside each question opens the original paper's page. A digest is read first and never cited.

panel.title: Literature digests {count}
panel.openTip: Open the literature digest in the library

request.label: Literature digest request · {workflow}
request.expand: Show the instructions the AI agent received
request.collapse: Hide the instructions the AI agent received
